admissible_source_evidence.variant_a:
DELEGATION RECORD
Subject: scheduling of check-in reminders
Requested by: the member, on the ninth
Accepted by: the steward
Period: four weeks, beginning the ninth
During the period:
  the steward sets reminder times
  the member may switch reminders off altogether
  the member may not change reminder times
At the end of the period: scheduling returns to the member automatically
Check-in answers: this delegation gives the steward no access to them
Record written by: the steward
Record confirmed by: the member
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b: On the ninth, the member asked the steward to take over the scheduling of check-in reminders for the four weeks starting that day, and the steward agreed. For those four weeks the steward decides when reminders are sent. The member can still switch reminders off altogether, but cannot change their times. When the four weeks are over, scheduling passes back to the member without any further step. This arrangement does not give the steward any access to the member's check-in answers. The steward wrote this record and the member confirmed it.
